correctness.rationale: For b>0 the monomial H² coefficient matrix is the stated product of gamma ratios. Comparing it with K_b(n,m)=n^b/(n+m)^{b+1} gives an explicit square-summable O(n^{b-1}/(n+m)^{b+1}+n^b/(n+m)^{b+2}) error; n=0 row and m=0 column have square-summable coefficients. Step-function discretization differs Hilbert–Schmidt from B_b(x,y)=x^b/(x+y)^{b+1} on L²([1,infinity)). Under logarithmic unitary Vf(s)=exp(s/2)f(exp s), this is the half-line convolution kernel q_b(u)=exp(u/2)/(1+exp u)^{b+1}. Euler beta integration gives Fourier symbol m_b(tau)=Gamma(1/2+i tau)Gamma(b+1/2-i tau)/Gamma(b+1). This q_b has integrable tails and finite cross-boundary square moment, so the half-line Wiener–Hopf compressions have compact off-diagonal blocks. For lambda nonzero outside the completed symbol curve a compressed full-line resolvent gives a Fredholm parametrix. For every value on the curve normalized escaping packets are weakly-null approximate kernel vectors; compact perturbations do not change Fredholmness. Closure adds 0. The digamma derivative at tau=0 is nonzero imaginary for b>0; for b=1 gamma recurrence yields pi(1/2-i tau)/cosh(pi tau). Independently spot-checked gamma matrix versus beta integrals and Mellin beta integrals for b=1/2,1,2 at multiple indices/parameters, corroborating the exact analytical proof.
